BRCA1.function: DNA damage repair and homologous recombination.
BRCA1.biomarker_role: Tumor suppressor and hereditary breast cancer biomarker.
BRCA1.clinical_note: Frequently altered in hereditary breast and ovarian cancer.

BRCA2.clinical_note: Associated with genomic instability and DNA repair defects.

TP53.function: Cell cycle regulation and apoptosis control.
TP53.biomarker_role: Major tumor suppressor altered in aggressive tumors.
TP53.clinical_note: Commonly associated with poor prognosis and genomic instability.

ERBB2.function: Receptor tyrosine kinase driving cell proliferation.
ERBB2.biomarker_role: Predictive biomarker for HER2-positive breast cancer.
ERBB2.clinical_note: Clinically actionable target for trastuzumab-based therapy.

ESR1.biomarker_role: Hormone receptor biomarker for luminal subtype.

PGR.function: Progesterone receptor involved in hormone response.
PGR.biomarker_role: Luminal subtype and endocrine response marker.
PGR.clinical_note: Used with ER status for clinical subtype classification.

MKI67.clinical_note: High expression is associated with aggressive proliferation.

MYC.clinical_note: Often elevated in aggressive and proliferative tumors.

PTEN.clinical_note: Loss may indicate pathway activation and poor prognosis.

CDH1.clinical_note: Reduced expression may indicate invasive progression.

EGFR.clinical_note: Often elevated in triple-negative breast cancer.

BCL2.clinical_note: Often associated with luminal and better prognosis.

CCND1.clinical_note: Amplification is common in luminal tumors.

AKT1.clinical_note: Frequently involved in oncogenic signaling activation.

PIK3CA.clinical_note: Frequently altered in hormone receptor-positive tumors.

MAP3K1.function: Kinase involved in stress and MAPK signaling.
MAP3K1.clinical_note: Commonly altered in luminal breast tumors.
